_about: Variant 2. The owner's four archetype situations as arcs: the same state machines as variant 1, evaluated by code each night. The Director cannot move an arc directly; it chooses intents, and an intent may only push an edge whose precondition code verifies. An intent that names an arc edge that is not available is rejected and the planner's choice stands. Every arc resets at the ring's turn except bond_of_four, whose trust persists.

situations.title: The Strays: tentless, unfed, blamed

groupEdges.when: two or more Strays socialised with each other today OR a fed character helped a Stray today
any Stray was helped twice in one day

perStrayOutcomes.when: trust(stray, m) >= 20 AND m is in tent t AND (trait(elder(t), warmth) >= 6 OR tentStores(t) >= 6)
perStrayOutcomes.effect: stray joins tent t at dawn; loyalty(stray) = 40; debt(stray, m) unchanged

perStrayOutcomes.when: a character with goal build_fifth_tent won a recruit contest against the stray
perStrayOutcomes.effect: stray pledges to the fifth circle; counts toward members(fifth)

perStrayOutcomes.when: group is desperate for 3 nights AND the Vigil pinned a theft on this stray (caught or framed)
perStrayOutcomes.effect: the Vigil hands the stray to the Lanista; the stray appears in the next Games wave 1 in conscript gear. The player can spare them with a staff strike at low HP (no kill) for +10 trust from every Stray and -5 renown with the crowd.

rules: Strays receive no ration; hunger +15 per day unless helped or working (+8 when working).
Walking past a begging Stray: trust(stray, walker) -5 and the memory walkedPast.
The Vigil investigates Strays first: any unexplained theft gives rng(0.5) to pin it on a Stray.
playerHooks: Bring a Stray to your elder: taken_in if your elder qualifies.
As Air: found the fifth circle with them.

situations.title: Schemes before the Games

edges.when: dayOfWeek >= 4 (in the 3-day slice: the evening of day 1)

steal.targetGets: loses one gear item until recovered, or tent stores -4

poison.targetGets: sick: maxStamina -20 and HP -10 in the next Games; cannot kill

persuade.targetGets: loyalty -15; if loyalty < 20 the defection rule may fire at dawn

rumour.targetGets: renown -3 (floor 0); characters whose values react to the rumour's topic change trust by the reaction table

situations.contest: schemer guile*4 + d20 must EXCEED the dc; +2 to the dc when the target knows a scheme is coming (a Knowing from a confidant)
situations.onFail: foiled; then the Vigil rolls d20 + 8 vs schemer guile*4 + 10: success means caught

caught.schemer: stocks next day (loses all slots), renown -5

situations.rumourHearing: heard by the starter's tent and the target's tent; when the target is one of the four mains, also by the other three mains. A listener whose trust toward the target is >= 20 disbelieves the rumour and does not react.

pushedBy.WATCH(schemer): learns the plan (a Knowing for the player if the player watched)
pushedBy.REPORT(schemer): Vigil investigates before the attempt: caught on d20 + 8 > guile*4 + 10

situations.title: Rivals at home, friends abroad
rules: Same tent, same rank pairs lose 1 pairTrust a day (they compete for one slot).
Cross-tent, equal rank pairs gain +50% from socialising at the Commons (+9 instead of +6).
The Tent Trial on the day before the Games decides one entrant per tent: bout 50%, elder trust 30%, renown 20%.

edges.when: loser has warmth >= 5 OR winner helped loser this week
otherwise; loser gets goal revenge(winner) if aggression >= 6
the pair is drawn against each other in the Games
after the bout the winner has honour or warmth >= 6: pairTrust +10

pushedBy.DEFECT: only when loyalty < 20; resolves rivalry by leaving

situations.title: The four who came through the Door together

edges.when: at least 3 of the 6 pairs among the four mains have pairTrust >= 20 (mains' trust persists across loops, so this often fires early in Loop 1)
the player attends the Fourth Watch at the Well and the four choose a plan
all 6 pairs >= 40 AND one plan step is complete
any pair < -20 OR one of the four reported another to the Vigil
the player completes the reconciliation quest 'Salt and Bread'

plans.goal: each of the four wins their Tent Trial

steps: win Old Quill's trust (40) or Guile 3
read the Well stones at night
agree the Breaking with the other finalist

situations.voting: each main votes for the plan that best serves their goal; ties go to the plan the player proposed. Brennic prefers positions, Cassia knowledge, Garran escape, Iskar escape (but only after the fifth tent exists).
